correct_query: SELECT d.name AS dept_name, doc.name AS doctor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) AS total_patients, SUM(t.cost + m.base_price) AS total_revenue FROM Departments d JOIN Doctors doc ON d.dept_id = doc.dept_id JOIN Treatments t ON doc.doc_id = t.doc_id JOIN Admissions a ON t.admit_id = a.admit_id JOIN Prescriptions p ON t.treat_id = p.treat_id JOIN Medications m ON p.med_id = m.med_id WHERE a.discharge_date IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', a.admit_date) = '2023' GROUP BY d.name, doc.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
